title: A kb-content research gate that names a token as a fact's subject is not classed secrets
goal: bl_authority classes a gate of an item whose touches are all kb content as secrets only when its words act on a credential, not when an option names one as a research topic (SP-46k7sw57: ST-lbpkvzha's where-to-write gate matched 'app-token' and became an operator-only blocking gate); a code item's gate about a bearer token stays secrets
